summary: Tested the new BAKĒD Super App main home (CMS module=baked) and the global Light/Dark theme on the Expo web preview at 390x844, plus the backend. BACKEND: 9/9 pytest pass. Public /api/homepage for CI and IN returns the 5 sections in order (grid, food row, mart row, shop row, promo; row source is config.source_module). Admin list includes the app_* section types. PATCH config and is_enabled work, and /homepage/version changes after a PATCH. Reorder works. Create then delete a section works (deleting it again returns 404). Without auth the admin API returns 401/403. Customer preferences accept theme dark/light/system and return 422 for 'blue'. All test data was restored. FRONTEND DARK: header bell, cart, address-bar and home-search-button render. The 6 tiles sit in a 3x2 grid with FR CMS taglines. IMMO and AUTO show BIENTÔT, are aria-disabled, and tapping them does nothing. SEND/FOOD/MART/SHOP open module-home-{express,food,mart,shop}. Category tiles and View All links go to the right routes (/food/discover?category=burgers, /mart/category/fruits-vegetables, /shop/category/mode-femme, /food/discover, /mart/category/all, /shop/category/all). app-promo-0 opens FOOD home and app-promo-1 opens MART home. CMS: disabling the shop row and editing the SEND tagline in admin both show after reload; restored. EN: 'Deliver Anything', 'Order your bites', 'View All', 'Order Now' and 'SOON' all appear. THEME: profile-item-appearance opens /appearance. Choosing Light switches to app-root-light at once and the user stays on /appearance. localStorage baked_theme_mode is '"light"'. Back goes to profile ('Mode clair'), and a reload keeps light. System mode follows prefers-color-scheme, including a live switch. Logged in (OTP +225 0700000000): choosing a theme sends PATCH {theme:'light'} (200). After clearing local storage and reloading, the theme comes back from the account. Admin web UI hp-module-baked lists the 5 baked sections. A light-mode contrast scan plus screenshots covered home, explore, activity, profile, cart, MART category and product, FOOD discover, a restaurant page, SEND book, login and the 4 module homes. Most screens read well. Several light-mode readability bugs were found (below).

ui_bugs.component: FoodSections hero mode pills (À emporter / Sur place)
ui_bugs.issue: LIGHT mode: inactive pills are white text and icon (#fff hard-coded) on styles.mode backgroundColor colors.surface (#F5F5F5). Contrast is 1.09, so the text cannot be read inside the dark hero.
LIGHT mode: the ETA AppText has no color, so it falls back to colors.text #111 on rgba(0,0,0,0.7). The '20–30 min' text is invisible (FoodSections.tsx line 168).
LIGHT mode: text is hard-coded #FDE68A (pale yellow) on a pale amber background over white. Contrast is 1.25, so it is unreadable (FoodSections.tsx line 60).
LIGHT mode: the active pill has bg colors.text (#111) and text hard-coded '#000', so 'FR'/'EN' is invisible. Use colors.bg for the active text colour.
Logo drops testID when no onPress is passed, so main-logo is not in the DOM (count 0). Pass testID to the Image.

integration_issues.issue: Code review: after login, ThemeContext replaces the local mode with the account preference. GET /me/preferences defaults theme to 'dark' even if it was never set, so a guest who chose Light flips to Dark after signing in. Push the local mode up when the account has no explicit theme, or don't default theme on the server.

issues: Yellow and orange accent text on white or #F5F5F5 is hard to read. SHOP #FCC44C is 1.47–1.6 (module name, 'Voir tout', active tab label). IMMO and the BIENTÔT badge #F5B70A are 1.65–1.8. SEND #F5A524 is 1.87–2.0 (tile name, 'Ajouter un arrêt', active tab). Use a darker shade of the accent for text in light mode while keeping accent fills.
The Google map keeps the dark style in light mode. Consider a light map style.
The tagline 'Courses en quelques minutes' is cut to 'Courses en quelques ...' (numberOfLines=2 at 390px).

action_items: FoodSections.tsx: give inactive hero mode pills a dark-glass style (bg rgba(255,255,255,0.08), border rgba(255,255,255,0.2)) instead of colors.surface/colors.border.
FoodSections.tsx line 168: set the ETA badge AppText color to '#fff'.
FoodSections.tsx line 60: make the address prompt text colour theme-aware (e.g. #92400E in light).
LangToggle.tsx: active text colour should be colors.bg, not '#000'.
Logo.tsx: pass testID to the Image when onPress is absent.
ThemeContext: don't let the server default 'dark' override a guest's local choice on first login.
Optional: darker accent text shades for SHOP, IMMO and SEND in light mode; light Google map style.
critical_code_review_comments: theme.ts applyScheme() mutates module state during ThemeModeProvider render (side effect in render). It works because Stack is keyed by scheme, but that remount resets navigation state. On /appearance this is fine today, but any in-progress screen state (forms, scroll) is lost when the system theme changes.
Hard-coded hex text colours (#fff/#000/#FDE68A) inside themed() styles cause most of the light-mode bugs. Grep for color="#000"/'#fff' used next to colors.* backgrounds.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Temporary TEST_row section was created and deleted. Shop row toggle and tagline edit were restored. Customer +2250700000000 theme was restored to dark.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To land on the main home, clear localStorage baked_active_context (the selected module persists). Set baked_theme_mode='"light"' to force light. Login on web: normal click (not force) on login-submit, read the code from otp-dev-code, type it into otp-input. The light-mode contrast scanner JS is in this iteration's run: it walks ancestors to find the effective bg and flags ratio <2.2. Retest the FOOD module home in light (hero pills, ETA badge, address prompt), LangToggle, and guest-light then login.
rca of the issue: Light-mode unreadable text comes from components that mix themed backgrounds (colors.surface/colors.text) with hard-coded text colours meant for dark mode (#fff in the FOOD hero pills, #000 in LangToggle, #FDE68A in the address prompt), or from text with no colour (it defaults to colors.text #111) on a fixed dark scrim (the FOOD ETA badge). Repro: set baked_theme_mode '"light"', open the FOOD tile and view the hero and Restaurants populaires; or open Profile and look at the Langue toggle.
